proof_status meanings: source_proven = follows from readable source;

bundle shows it; unproven = declared, no proof yet; withheld = should not

one character selected, so other multi-recipient semantics remain declared
rather than demonstrated. close_trade_window is separately live-proven as a
native recovery command, not a registry-backed gameplay operation.
Reverse-engineering conclusions live only under game_sources/research;
entries here link to those packages instead of restating their argument.
